Rory's Beach Bar at Cây Sao is not an accident. Over a thousand people sat here, cold drink in hand, and came back to rate it. That's not luck.

Cold beers, sand underfoot, and zero pretension. The kind of bar you find on day one and return to every day after.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
